isotope.blurb: A waste treatment plant on the night shift: spent fuel glowing green in the storage pools and the cooling pond, sodium lamps over the rest, cooling towers looming through the smog.

spots.name: Pump House
spots.text: The pump house stands mid-map with its deck at 7 m, and a ramp climbs to it from the east. The reactor core under the deck glows green through its casing and lights the hall below, which you can enter through a gap in the middle of each wall.

spots.name: Storage Pool and Gantry Crane
spots.text: In each west yard, spent fuel glows in the storage pool under a gantry crane that rides the perimeter walls, with its cask hanging 9.5 m over the pool. The shielded hot cell stands beside the pool with its window glowing, and waste containers around the yard give cover.

spots.name: Cooling Pond
spots.text: On the east side a tank farm surrounds a glowing cooling pond. The 9 m tanks, joined by pipes, give hard cover, and a 3 m platform with a ramp up from the west stands just south of the pond.

sump.blurb: A flooded undercity: an old street grid knee deep in water under the city deck its buildings hold up, opened by light wells, ramp wells and a trench down the middle.

spots.name: The Trench
spots.text: The center avenue lies open through the city deck for 46 m, splitting the map down the middle. A ramp at each end runs down to the flooded streets 8 m below, and a footbridge crosses the middle at deck level.

spots.name: The Undercity
spots.text: The old street grid runs 8 m below the city deck with 7.5 m of headroom, knee deep in water and lit by cyan lamps and wall signs. Its streets link the trench, the wells and the ramp slot up to each base yard.

spots.name: East Roof
spots.text: The east roof stands 7 m above the deck, up a ramp from it. Below it the east well drops to the flooded streets, with a ramp back up to the deck and a jump pad from the well's corner onto the east hall's deck.

verdigris.blurb: A green-lit city on four levels under acid rain: drains, streets, roofs at 7 m and a viaduct at 14 m, neon running down the towers.

spots.name: Market Square
spots.text: Inside the viaduct ring, 3 m market stalls that work as cover and hover-ups stand around the 26 m clock tower. In Missile Assault this is objective B, with the ring as the high ground over it.

spots.name: Viaduct
spots.text: The highest level is a square ring 14 m up on pillars around the market, linking all three Missile Assault silos. You reach it by the transit ramp from each base plaza or by the ramps up from the east and west districts' roof landings.

spots.name: Storm Drain
spots.text: The lowest level is a 10 m wide drain 7 m below the streets, running in front of each base. It passes under four grated street bridges and has a ramp up at each end.

sinkhole.blurb: An open-pit mine under dust: benches stepping down to a flooded floor, a double spiral of haul ramps, three bridges across the middle, and old workings under each side's rim.

spots.name: Pit Floor
spots.text: The pit's flooded floor at -28 is objective B in Missile Assault, under all three bridges: the conveyor gantry at -7, the haul road at 0 and the high bridge at +8. Haul ramps spiral up the benches, and jump pads throw mechs out to the east and west rims.

spots.name: Headframe and Shaft
spots.text: Under each team's front rim lie the old workings: a station at -14 that opens onto the pit's -14 bench. You reach it down a broad haul decline, a narrower drift, or this open shaft under the headframe; drop in, and the cage pad at the bottom throws you back out in front of the base's west gate.

spots.name: Bucket-Wheel Excavator
spots.text: A bucket-wheel excavator stands on each side rim with its boom out over the pit, the boom 12 m over the rim at its lowest and the wheel 9 m clear of the benches. South of it, a narrow adit runs in under the rim from the -7 bench up to the surface.

ziggurat.blurb: A snowfield round a squat stepped pyramid faced in ice nobody can climb. Trenches cut it into four lobes that meet in the Vault under the top; each lobe has one way up.

spots.name: The Vault
spots.text: Four 10 m trenches cut the pyramid into lobes and meet under its top in the Vault, a 28 m hall around a core column. In Missile Assault this is objective B, with its launch pad on the roof above.

spots.name: Toppled Radar Dish
spots.text: On the north-west lobe a toppled radar dish leans on the ice face with its top rim on the ledge's edge, making a round ramp from the snow up to the 15 m ledge. The 60-degree ice faces can't be climbed, so everywhere else off the faces is a drop.

spots.name: Grand Stair
spots.text: Each lobe has a grand stair that climbs straight from the snow to the 30 m top, with lamps at its foot and red lights either side of its head. The north-east lobe's stair runs up its north face.

foundry.blurb: An industrial yard on the night shift, on four levels: the cooling channel with slag glowing in its gutters, the ground, decks at 7 m and gantries at 14 m.

spots.name: The Smelter
spots.text: The centre of the map is a soot core with its roof at 14 m and a ring deck at 7 m over an arcade lit by furnace mouths. A ramp climbs to the ring and rust blocks make hover steps on to the roof. The Siege station and silo B sit in the arcade round the core, and the AA gun and B's launch pad are on the roof.

spots.name: Cooling Channel
spots.text: A 14 m wide trench runs 5 m below the yard through the east half, with a twin in the west. Slag glows in gutters along both walls and the lane between them stays clear. A 9 m ramp at each end climbs to the smelter's platform at one end and to the land bridge by the perimeter at the other.

spots.name: Skybridge
spots.text: A railed deck at 14 m runs on three pillars from the base gantry, over the courtyard, to the smelter's roof. It and the hover steps are the ways up to the AA gun on the roof.

riftline.blurb: A lavender canyon split by a chasm, a fissure glowing violet down its floor, crossed by a three-deck bridge whose rail deck runs on to both bases as the high road.

spots.name: The Bridge
spots.text: Three decks cross the chasm at mid-map: a service gantry at -8, the road at 0 and the rail deck at +10. The rail deck runs on over both rims to the bases as the high road. The Siege station and silo B are on the road deck, with the AA gun and B's launch pad on the rail deck above.

spots.name: Switchback Stairs
spots.text: Metal ramps zigzag up the canyon wall from the floor at -24 to the -16 and -8 terraces and on to the rim, with a landing at each turn. There are two flights on each wall, and a jump pad near each end of the floor goes straight up to the rim. There is no fall damage, so the chasm is a slow road rather than a pit.

spots.name: Broken Pipelines
spots.text: On each side of the bridge a 3.8 m duct runs across the chasm at rim level, torn in the middle. Crossing its 12 m gap takes a hover. Below it on the -8 terrace there is 6.2 m of clearance, enough for a Heavy to pass under.

crashsite.blurb: A swamp where a freighter came down bow first and broke in four. The fight is on, in, under and between the pieces: the water and holds, the mid decks, the top decks up to 30 m.

spots.name: The Bow
spots.text: The freighter's nose is buried in the mound it pushed up. Its top deck climbs at 16 degrees to a 24 m overlook at the broken end, with containers caught on the slope, and silo A sits on this sloping deck. Inside are a hold and a mid deck joined by a ramp, and a girder runs on to the midship's top deck.

spots.name: Midship Hold
spots.text: The midship's hold sits at the water line under a mid deck at 9 m and a top deck at 18 m, whose hatches don't line up. The Siege station and silo B are down here. Ramps at either end climb from deck to deck, and the sides are breached to the water.

spots.name: The Stern
spots.text: The stern is rolled onto its starboard side. Its keel is a ramp up from the water to a ridge walk along the top, and its deck face leans out over the water, holed by a window from the cavern inside. Silo C covers the cavern and its fallen deck, with its launch pad up on the ridge.

span.blurb: A desert at noon, crossed by a broken arch that climbs to 36 m and stops short over the middle, above a fallen block. Mesas and slot canyons stand between the walled corner yards.

spots.name: The Broken Arch
spots.text: From a town at each end, the arch climbs to 36 m over the middle and can be walked all the way up. Its two arms stop 24 m short of each other, so the top gives a view but no way across.

spots.name: The Keystone
spots.text: A fallen block lies under the arch's gap, with a ramp up each long side. In Siege the station rings its foot and the AA gun is on top. In Missile Assault it is silo B, with the launch pad in the open beside it.

spots.name: The Mesa
spots.text: A 14 m mesa stands between each yard and the middle, with a sand drift running up its back from the yard's side. Outcrops off its ends leave 10 m slot canyons. Silo A is on top of the NE mesa and silo C on the SW one.

canopy.blurb: The last living forest, and not quite right. Rolling ground walled by cliffs: a gorge up one flank, a knoll mid-map, and the Crown, a rise under the mother tree.

spots.name: The Knoll
spots.text: A hill mid-map under a rock table, with a ramp up its south side and a pinnacle a hover above it. Two sides can hold it as an overlook against each other. The Siege AA gun and silo B are on the table.

spots.name: The Gorge
spots.text: A 15 m canyon with sheer walls runs up the west flank. The ways out are its ends, a breach in its east wall, and the jump pad on its floor. A fallen giant and a stone arch from the Pulpit bridge it, and silo A is on its floor by the breach.

spots.name: The Spine
spots.text: A 14 m stone ridge up the east flank, its crest walkable from either end, with ledges up its sides and a 10 m wide tunnel through it. It is the east's overlook and its choke point. Silo C is at the tunnel, with its launch pad by the west mouth.

hivewall.blurb: A mining colony carved into a cliff over a canyon and taken by the Bloom, a glowing orange fungus. Three mine mouths on the canyon floor feed three climbs, 96 m up to the reactor on the Crest.

spots.name: The Workings
spots.text: The flooded mine galleries on the canyon floor lie 12 m below Low Town, the Bloom's light deep in them. The three mine mouths in the far wall are Co-op Defense's gates, one under the foot of each climb, and a 14 m ramp runs up from each to Low Town.

spots.name: The Stair
spots.text: The main lane: four 14 m wide flights switch back up the middle of the face, 23 degrees each, with a terrace at 24, 48 and 72 m between them and the last flight onto the Crest. Towers go on the terraces and beside the landings, and a chain of jump pads takes pilots from Low Town up the face to the Crest.

spots.name: The Shaft
spots.text: On the west flank an old ore lift stands with a 28 m square core, and a 14 m ramp spirals up round it, a storey a side over seven sides. It is wide enough for brutes and bosses, so they come this way as well as by the Stair, and a one-way link at 48 m crosses over to the Stair.

spots.name: The Warren
spots.text: The east climb runs through the insides of a tenement: seven 10 m halls switch back between landing rooms lit by cold tubes, in by a tunnel off Low Town and out onto the Crest. Its lane is too narrow for brutes and bosses, which keep to the Stair and the Shaft where they can.

spots.name: The Crest and Reactor
spots.text: At the top of the cliff, 84 m over Low Town, the atmosphere plant's plaza holds the reactor, and the pilots' spawns are behind it. All three climbs come out on the Crest and end at the reactor, with open ground round it to fight on and no tower nearer than 12 m.

walled.blurb: A walled city stacked 100 m deep on both sides of a gorge at dusk, crossed by the city itself at every height. Old money lives in warm plaster and lantern light on the west side; the east is tenements, neon and fluorescent tubes.

spots.name: The Wall and its Well
spots.text: The city spans the gorge at its middle around a well 32 m square, open from the canal to the sky, with galleries looking down it from every level. In Missile Assault silo B is on the canal at its foot, between two blocks moored for cover.

spots.name: The X
spots.text: Two enclosed blocks cross the gorge diagonally at level 3 and meet in the middle, with the Wall ahead split warm and cold down the gorge. Bridge blocks cross at other heights, and footbridges at odd angles at levels 6 and 8.

spots.name: The Canal
spots.text: Black water on the gorge floor, under every crossing, with boats moored as cover. Dock stairs climb both faces to the low bridges at level 1, and a pad mid-canal on each side throws you up onto the galleries by the Wall at level 2.

spots.name: The Monorail
spots.text: A ring at level 5 round the whole city, jogging out to its outer wall and back so no stretch runs long, and crossing the gorge in enclosed bridges at both ends. Each base is on it, and in Convoy the hauler runs along its south side.

spots.name: The Spawn Halls
spots.text: Each team spawns at level 4 in a hall of pillars, red lacquer in the west and rusted in the east, under the monorail, with its base guns covering it. In Capture the Flag its flag stand is 60 m on toward the gorge, where the hall's ways out meet.

spots.name: The Roofs
spots.text: Walkable roofs at level 8 between towers rising to 128 m, cluttered with sheds, tanks, poles and cables: lantern strings in the west, washing and neon billboards in the east. Low parapets give cover from one roof to the next.
